prompts.name: 玻璃焦散｜清水与矿物绿反光
prompts.text:
为当代环境健康品牌拍摄的高级杂志广告摄影。一个薄壁圆柱饮水杯，盛有完全透明的水，旁边放一支小型无标记、带盖的实验室水样采样瓶；两者以精确的不对称间距摆放在无缝哑光白色台面。近距离四分之三视角，物体占据竖版构图的大部分。左上方强而可控的日光产生复杂光学焦散与清晰长阴影。画外一块半透明矿物绿色玻璃板，在背景投下微妙绿光，而水本身保持完全无色。杯沿、弯月面、折射和表面纹理极其真实。克制、清净、安静而引人入胜，精致静物美术指导，中画幅商业摄影，整洁宽松的边距。白色和浅青瓷色调，深森林绿色阴影点缀。负面要求：无文字、标志、标签、水印、气泡、飞溅、植物或人物。

--no text, logos, labels, watermarks, bubbles, splashes, plants, people --ar 4:5 --raw --v 8.2
prompts.originalText: Premium editorial campaign photograph for a contemporary environmental health brand. A single thin-walled cylindrical drinking glass filled with perfectly transparent water, beside a small unmarked capped laboratory water-sampling vial, arranged with precise asymmetrical spacing on a seamless matte white surface. Close three-quarter viewpoint, objects fill most of the vertical composition. Strong controlled daylight from the upper left creates intricate optical caustics and long crisp shadows. A translucent mineral-green glass panel outside the frame casts a subtle green reflection across the background, while the water itself remains completely colorless. Extraordinary realism in the glass edges, meniscus, refraction and surface texture. Restrained, clinical, quietly intriguing, sophisticated still-life art direction, medium-format commercial photography, generous clean margins, white and pale celadon palette with deep forest-green shadow accents. --no text, logos, labels, watermarks, bubbles, splashes, plants, people --ar 4:5 --raw --v 8.2
